description: Source code implementing the ThreadCpuUsage class for tracking CPU usage per thread, including enabling/disabling measurement, sampling, elapsed time calculation, and CPU frequency retrieval.

classes.name: ThreadCpuUsage
classes.description: Class for measuring thread CPU usage and CPU frequency.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables CPU usage measurement for the thread.

methods.name: sampleAndEnable
methods.description: Samples CPU usage and enables measurement if not already enabled.

methods.name: elapsed
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time in nanoseconds since last reset.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes CPU count and file descriptors for CPU frequency.

methods.name: getCpukHz
methods.description: Retrieves the current CPU frequency in kHz for a given CPU number.
